description: Set, change or stop a brand's MARKET RADAR (the standing competitor watch; Ad Spy > Watching in the web app; each brand has its own), run weekly or daily: newAds (what watched brands launched), winners (their ad passing 30 days running), trends + topPosts (formats and most-viewed posts for niche topics), ideas (3 to make). Only what you pass changes. competitors / topics REPLACE their lists (max 8 brands, 5 topics); both empty stops it and clears findings. auto:true picks 3-5 competitors, 2-3 similar brands and 2-3 topics from the saved brand or `seed` (a few credits). dryRun:true quotes one check, saves nothing. Saving is free; each check holds its quote first and is skipped when the balance is short. runNow is refused while a check runs or just after one finished. Read it with list_watch_findings.

auto.description: true picks competitors, similar brands and topics from the saved brand or seed; costs a few credits

brand.description: profile id/name from list_brands, this call only

domain.description: e.g. ridge.com: Google is read by domain, and it finds the right Meta page

dryRun.description: true quotes one check and saves nothing

force.description: with runNow: check again right after a check, allowed once what is watched changed

ideas.description: true includes three ideas to make from the findings

newAds.description: true includes new ads the watched brands launched

topPosts.description: true includes the most-viewed posts for the topics

trends.description: true includes formats trending in the topics

winners.description: true includes watched ads that have run 30 days

seed.description: for auto: a website, brand or niche

name: set_competitor_watch
title: Set the market radar
